methodologyNotes: Pricing re-verified via WebFetch on each vendor's official pricing page (cloudinary.com/pricing, filecamp.com/pricing, dash.app/pricing, pics.io/pricing, help.air.inc pricing article, canto.com/pricing, mediavalet.com/pricing, bynder.com/en/pricing, brandfolder.com/pricing, acquia.com/products/acquia-dam/pricing-plans). Daminion was NOT in the draft vendor list (mentioned in methodology only) and is not present. Quote-only vendors (Canto, MediaValet, Bynder, Brandfolder, Acquia DAM) plus the Enterprise tiers of Cloudinary/Pics.io/Air carry monthlyUsd=null. Dash publishes natively in GBP (Start up £79 / Small team £179 / Growing brand £299 / Established brand £449) with an on-page currency selector; the entry-tier USD ($109) is corroborated by Dash's own blog ('from £79 or $109 a month'), and the three higher USD figures are approximations derived from the same rate and flagged in notes. Compliance set true only where the vendor explicitly claims it on a trust/security page: Cloudinary HIPAA DOWNGRADED to null (trust page references the 'HIPAA Security Rule' only inside SOC 2 scope, no standalone HIPAA claim); Filecamp GDPR DOWNGRADED to null (page attributes SOC/HIPAA/GDPR posture to Azure, no direct Filecamp claim). Dash 'ISO 27001:2013 certified' claim REMOVED (security overview attributes certifications to AWS, not Dash). accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Cloudinary
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched from cloudinary.com/pricing (DAM product line only: Free + Enterprise, no intermediate paid DAM tier published). Compliance from cloudinary.com/trust. HIPAA downgraded from true to null: the trust page references the 'HIPAA Security Rule' only as part of the SOC 2 examination criteria, not as a standalone HIPAA compliance claim.

plans.name: DAM Free
plans.notes: 25 GB storage, 3 users, 1 account. Includes auto-tagging, video support, asset variation presets. Forever free, no credit card required.

plans.name: DAM Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom storage and users. Full collaboration suite, AI-powered content operations, enterprise SLAs. Contact sales (no published price).

keyFeatures: CDN delivery with global edge nodes
Asset variation presets (one file, many formats)
bestFor: Media-heavy products needing both DAM and API delivery
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from cloudinary.com/pricing; compliance from cloudinary.com/trust confirms SOC 2 Type II (produced by Deloitte), GDPR, and ISO 27001. The page mentions the HIPAA Security Rule only within SOC 2 scope, so a standalone HIPAA claim is not supported (set null).

vendors.name: Filecamp
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched from filecamp.com/pricing (Basic $29, Advanced $59, Professional $89 — all confirmed; annual = monthly x12, no annual discount). The 30-day Pro free trial applies to ALL new accounts (corrected from draft, which restricted it to Professional). Security page attributes SOC/HIPAA/GDPR to Microsoft Azure; Filecamp makes no direct compliance claim.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: 20 GB storage, unlimited users, custom branding. Storage add-ons from $10/mo per 10 GB. No annual discount ($348/yr = $29x12).

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: 50 GB storage, unlimited users. Adds multiple themes, custom pages, collections, auto-tags. No annual discount ($708/yr).

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: 100 GB storage, unlimited users. Adds white-label, custom domain, commenting/proofing, access requests, bulk auto-tags. No annual discount ($1,068/yr). A 30-day Pro free trial is available to all new accounts.

enrichment.provenance: Pricing and trial from filecamp.com/pricing (30-day Pro trial applies to all new accounts). Security page attributes SOC 1/2/3, HIPAA, and GDPR support to its Microsoft Azure host, not to Filecamp directly; all three compliance flags set null since Filecamp makes no first-party claim.

vendors.name: Dash (by Bright)
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched from dash.app/pricing. Page displays GBP natively: Start up £79/mo (£853/yr), Small team £179/mo (£1,933/yr), Growing brand £299/mo (£3,229/yr), Established brand £449/mo (£4,849/yr); all 10% off annually. Entry-tier USD ($109) is corroborated by Dash's blog ('from £79 or $109 a month'); the three higher USD figures are approximations from the same rate and flagged as such. 14-day free trial, no forever-free tier.

plans.name: Start up
plans.notes: Published as £79/mo (£853/yr). 10 GB storage (+£25/mo per 10 GB), unlimited users, 250 downloads/month, all features unlocked. USD $109 confirmed by Dash blog. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Small team
plans.notes: Published as £179/mo (£1,933/yr). 50 GB storage, unlimited users, 500 downloads/month. USD ~$247 is an approximation derived from the £79=$109 rate, not a published USD figure.

plans.name: Growing brand
plans.notes: Published as £299/mo (£3,229/yr). 100 GB storage, unlimited users, 1,000 downloads/month. USD ~$413 is an approximation, not a published USD figure.

plans.name: Established brand
plans.notes: Published as £449/mo (£4,849/yr). 200 GB-50 TB storage, unlimited users, unlimited downloads. USD ~$589 is an approximation, not a published USD figure.

keyFeatures: All features unlocked from entry tier
Download limits as usage throttle (not per-user pricing)
Prices published natively in GBP with on-page USD/EUR/AUD/CAD toggle
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from dash.app/pricing (GBP-native; USD entry tier confirmed via blog). Security overview acknowledges GDPR obligations (gdpr=true) but attributes certifications to AWS, not Dash. The draft's 'ISO 27001:2013 certified infrastructure' keyFeature was removed because the security page does not claim ISO 27001 for Dash.

vendors.name: Pics.io
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched from pics.io/pricing (Solo $100, Micro $250, Small $800 confirmed; Enterprise custom). Annual discounts confirmed (Micro 10% -> $225/mo, Small 15% -> $680/mo; Solo no discount). Integrations and GDPR footer badge from pics.io/integrations. 7-day trial, no forever-free tier.

plans.name: Solo
plans.notes: 1 user, 100 GB+ storage. Basic integrations, 10 sharing links. No annual discount. Extra users $25 each. 7-day free trial.

plans.name: Micro
plans.notes: 10+ users, 1 TB+ storage or BYOS. Adds version control, commenting, 24/7 support. Annual $225/mo ($2,700/yr), saves 10%. Most popular tier.

plans.name: Small
plans.notes: 50+ users, 3 TB+ storage or BYOS. Adds branding, watermarking, API access. Annual $680/mo ($8,160/yr), saves 15%.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: 100+ users, 5 TB+ storage or BYOS. Adds Okta SSO, unlimited trainings. Contact sales (no published price).

limits: 1 user minimum on Solo, 10+ on Micro, 50+ on Small
keyFeatures: BYOS (Bring Your Own Storage) — connect existing Google Drive or S3
Deep Adobe Creative Cloud integration (5 apps)
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from pics.io/pricing (Solo/Micro/Small confirmed, Enterprise custom). 'EU GDPR compliant' footer badge confirmed on pics.io/integrations; SOC2 and HIPAA not claimed.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 120 credits/month. Credits cover storage (~6 credits/GB/month), AI enrichment, and AI generation. Unlimited workspace users. Forever free — not a trial.

plans.name: Starter

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: 30,000 credits/month (~5,000 GB storage equivalent). Annual billing $10,800/year. Unlimited users — not per-seat.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: 60,000 credits/month base. Enterprise-grade security, SSO, custom permissions. Contact sales (no published price).

limits: Credits cover storage + AI at ~6 credits/GB/month
keyFeatures: Credit-based model covering storage, AI enrichment, and AI generation
Unlimited users on all plans — never per-seat
Visual-first workspace with board-style asset browsing
bestFor: Teams wanting unlimited collaborators without per-seat cost
